propositions: managed_refs marks a link managed upon local creation but cannot distinguish never-pushed local links from peer-deleted links, creating a blind spot in the inbound removal path

outbound_links dedups ADDs direction-agnostically on (vendor_type, target_key) without relation deduping, allowing local links colliding with inbound links in opposite direction to never be pushed yet vulnerable to unprotected removal
inbound removal records can delete never-peer-confirmed links when outbound differ does not re-emit the ADD, violating the safety contract

a durable peer-confirmation record keyed by (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) must persist in .bridge_state and survive SNAPSHOT compaction to discriminate never-pushed links from peer deletions
removal records must be declined for managed-but-never-peer-confirmed links and logged, while removal of peer-confirmed links continues to converge relation-scoped
completeness of fetched authoritative snapshots determines confirmation eligibility: absent issuelinks key means unobserved, empty list means authoritatively empty, and populated means evidence
